systems.country_label: the national network; a private government network
systems.platform: copper links from 2001 (Frame Relay, ADSL, SHDSL from 2005), fibre optic from 2009; email, VoIP and video-conference services
systems.owner: National Information Center (NIC), Ministry of Communication and Information Technology
systems.tiers: 35 federal ministries and 15 government secretariats linked in 2001; video-conference between the Council of Ministers and the states; described as linking all state facilities and all governmental institutions, with no local government office named
launched 2010; hosts applications and databases of government institutions; links to Electronic Banking Services, Civil Registration and Higher Education

note: The NIC's own 2016 deck describes the government network at federal ministries, government secretariats and, for video-conference, the states; it puts no locality or other local government office on it, so the network is backbone and gives no fact. Its national e-services (the eGov portal, SADAD payments, E15 fee collection) are central government applications outside the study's classes.
